subscription_not_found.title: {name}: calendar subscription not reporting data
subscription_not_found.description:
The remote calendar subscription for integration instance "{name}" is not reporting data. The provider returned `"type":"SubscriptionNotFound"`.

The subscription may have expired or been removed by the provider. Obtain a new calendar subscription URL from your provider, then open Settings > Devices & services > Remote Calendar Retain and configure or reconfigure "{name}" to replace its Calendar URL.

This repair will clear automatically after the calendar refreshes successfully.
